nodes.risk: Recursive self-deception: generating elegant explanations, internal scores, simulations and plans that look like progress while reality does not change.
rules: real customer acceptance outranks synthetic fixtures
a skipped or silent instrument never counts as pass
every success claim names its evidence tier
missing proof remains UNKNOWN, not PASS
simpler conventional mechanisms remain benchmark opponents
nodes.title: Anti-self-deception doctrine — the greatest strategic risk

nodes.hard_rule: Never convert "not implemented today" into "not actually intended".
nodes.statement: Every serious founder aspiration remains part of the intended horizon unless Alfonso explicitly supersedes it, evidence proves the exact formulation incoherent, or the only available route is unlawful or unacceptably harmful.
nodes.title: Founder aspirations are real destinations, not decoration

nodes.pipeline: inspect -> extract primitive causal machinery -> remove original product assumptions -> mutate role, authority, incentives or consequence -> recombine with other mutated mechanisms -> require emergent UNIIMENTE-native capability
nodes.statement: The objective is to create the mechanisms that let UNIIMENTE build, test, organize, replace and govern whatever machinery its goals require — not to build another Git, database, compiler, OS, container engine, blockchain, search engine, game engine or AI model.
nodes.title: Build-Your-Own-X is a mechanism anatomy atlas, never a cloning roadmap

tiers.computational: generated or recombined software restores a disabled function under protected evaluation
tiers.economic: the workflow reaches an externally accepted, paid, reconciled outcome
tiers.institutional: the capability participates successfully in a complete cross-organ workflow
tiers.physical: a governed capability produces a verified outcome through a physical embodiment
tiers.scientific: a research program produces independently checked, reproducible new knowledge

nodes.title: Five-tier closure ladder — never let one tier masquerade as a higher one

nodes.behavioral_rule: Ruthless toward the problem. Humane toward the person.
roles: major and potentially primary early cash engine for UNIIMENTE
nodes.sequencing_consequence: Its early economic importance must be reflected in the construction sequence. A strong system that cannot finance itself remains fragile.
nodes.title: DALEOBANKS is a lifestyle brand, media network and early cash engine

nodes.statement: No agent may infer public deployment readiness merely from passing tests, green CI, merged code, simulations, benchmarks or architectural completeness. Preserve an approximately six-month founder-guided developmental revision period before public deployment or broad autonomous operation, unless Alfonso explicitly supersedes this requirement.
nodes.title: Approximately six months of founder-guided revision before public deployment

nodes.sequence: DALEOBANKS and Venture Cells create lawful value and cash flow -> reserves and obligations are satisfied -> founder-authorized surplus funds compute, tools, people and experiments -> better capability creates stronger ventures -> stronger ventures create more surplus -> surplus funds serious research and laboratories -> research creates knowledge and technology -> technology creates stronger infrastructure and ventures -> repeat
nodes.title: The economic and research flywheel

aspirations: human scientists and AI researchers collaborating
private compute clusters and future supercomputers
DALEOBANKS lifestyle and research cruises or other mobile campuses
geographically distributed nodes across countries and continents
nodes.discipline: Do not optimize for prestige artifacts before the capability-acquisition and economic flywheels work. Prefer usefulness and voluntary partnership.
nodes.title: Scientific and physical embodiments are downstream descendants

must_define: negative controls proving the evaluator can fail
truth labels when blind held-out isolation is not established
nodes.statement: Candidate generation is not the scarce primitive. Reliable judgment is. A system that generates impressive candidates but controls its own test is not improving.
nodes.title: Evaluator sovereignty is the deeper control layer

nodes.plain_english_question: What do we already have, what is connected, what is disconnected, what is genuinely missing, what should be canonical, what remains research, what gets built first, what proves it worked, and how does that move UNIIMENTE toward the full intended egregore?
required_outputs: one current institutional anatomy and ownership map
one existing-connected / existing-disconnected / absent capability classification
one Track A / Track B relationship
one Active Single Bottleneck Metric with baseline and target
one explicit mapping from today's next action to the extreme long-range aspiration
one strongest counterexample and falsification condition
one list of material aspirations preserved but intentionally not activated now
nodes.title: Required final decision geometry — fifteen outputs

nodes.caveat: A strong candidate because much of its repair laboratory already exists, but the round must verify whether whole-system connection work is a prerequisite before locking it as the active target.
closure_definition: detects a genuine missing or damaged function
identifies the phenotype contract and constraints
evaluates them using something candidates cannot alter
retains a qualifying champion and any useful specialists or fallbacks
attaches the capability only within the permitted consequence class
nodes.title: VERIFIED_DEVELOPMENTAL_CLOSURES: 0 -> 1

nodes.mature_model: Alfonso approves mission, policy, budget and operating territory -> Kernel converts them into standing authority -> routine compliant operations execute -> exceptions and reserved decisions escalate. Maximum operational independence inside bounded purpose, not per-action babysitting.
nodes.statement: The real Alfonso remains outside the software as owner, CEO and constitutional human authority. The internal founder representation, intent ledger, doctrine model and any future Founder Twin are not Alfonso and cannot impersonate him or exercise reserved powers.
nodes.title: Golden Kernel stays boring; the Founder Cockpit commands missions

constitutional_constraints: binds nothing unless a valid human or legal principal authorizes the act
cannot create its own ultimate purpose or expand its own authority
nodes.statement: The official project identity is fixed. "Artificial Egregore" is an identity and aspiration class, not a claim of consciousness, biological life, legal personhood, metaphysical reality, independent sovereignty, or authority separate from Alfonso Lopez.
nodes.title: UNIIMENTE: Artificial Egregore — Unified Internal Innovation Mind / Engine

nodes.discipline: Maintain one primary portfolio bottleneck; preserve the rest in the aspiration registry with status, dependencies, blockers, evidence and reactivation conditions.
nodes.method: G: observable success state / P: minimum stage-gated path / S: repeatable Tiny Yes system
nodes.mission: Continuously reduce the distance between Alfonso's active lawful aspirations and verified reality, use each achieved capability as substrate for harder aspirations, spread useful capability outward, and repeat.
nodes.title: Infinite Goal Chase

nodes.statement: Everything beneath the protected substrate may be challenged, mutated, recombined, replaced, specialized or retired from active use when a stronger architecture earns the role. Do not protect MICA, CDPE, Single-Flight, Foundry, OMNIMORPH, a workflow engine, blockchain, an agent framework, or any model provider merely because it already exists.
nodes.title: Everything below the protected substrate is malleable

nodes.statement: Founder language must be interpreted functionally. Every metaphor admitted to architecture must map to observable state, interfaces, mechanisms, tests, failure conditions, and evidence.
nodes.title: Metaphors translate to behavior — never discarded, never literalized

translations.grow_an_organ: construct or compose a bounded capability that did not previously exist
translations.mechanistically_alive: continuous sensing, memory, regulation, adaptation, capability construction, replacement, repair, learning and identity continuity in a nonbiological system
translations.morphogenesis: generate or reconfigure useful structure through whatever mechanism wins protected evaluation
translations.multiple_bodies: one governed institutional identity operating through several software, compute, organizational, IoT, robotic, laboratory, facility, vehicle, vessel or future physical interfaces
translations.self_healing: detect functional loss, generate or select repairs, verify restoration, preserve identity and evidence

evidence_refs.symbol: §8 AI models are replaceable cognitive organs

nodes.prohibition: Multiple AI accounts or providers may never be used to evade terms, impersonate people, manufacture consensus, or bypass authority.
nodes.statement: The frontier model supplies moment-to-moment reasoning. UNIIMENTE supplies continuity, memory, doctrine, tools, repositories, evidence, authority, evaluation, relationships and real-world feedback. Plan a provider-independent cognitive council and router.
nodes.title: AI models are replaceable cognitive organs, not institutional identity

nodes.gate: Any future consequential biological work requires separate domain-specific scientific evidence, legal review, biosafety, welfare analysis, independent oversight and explicit founder authorization.
nodes.statement: The aspiration may eventually include supporting diverse existing species, artificial intelligences, restored ecosystems and, if lawful and scientifically responsible, engineered biological systems. This mission document creates no biological authority.
nodes.title: Multi-species and engineered-life horizon creates no biological authority

evidence_refs.symbol: §27 The planning compiler is an instrument

required_disposition: retain it as a reusable planning capability
reduce it to generated artifacts and archive the compiler
integrate selected graph structures into the future institutional anatomy system
kill or simplify it if its maintenance cost exceeds its value
nodes.statement: Build the planning compiler because it prevents 25 drifting documents and gives the round a single source of planning truth. Do not let it become a permanent bureaucracy by default. Planning sophistication is not itself implementation progress.
nodes.title: The planning compiler is an instrument, not the new egregore

evidence_refs.symbol: §5 Preserve everything, but do not activate everything

nodes.statement: Default to preservation, registration, comparison, wrapping, adaptation, sandboxing, shadow operation, fallback status, historical replay and benchmark use. Never delete useful implementations merely to create a clean architecture. Never confuse preservation with active execution. One source of authority does not require one source of capability.
nodes.title: Preserve everything; activate deliberately

nodes.first_milestone: A secure, testnet, end-to-end funded job or service transaction with identity, eligibility, opportunity, commitment, proof, approval or dispute, settlement, reputation and greater future capability.
nodes.statement: Do not freeze PumpStation at an old branch description. The latest founder direction treats it as a first-class UNIIMENTE Venture Cell. Its provisional consumer-facing operating layer is MANO.
nodes.title: PumpStation is a regenerative social-economic operating system, not a memecoin launcher

nodes.analogy_scope: The military-industrial analogy is mechanical and organizational, not martial — long-horizon strategy, laboratories, research funding, procurement, engineering, manufacturing, logistics, standards, talent pipelines, distributed facilities, mission command, after-action learning.
nodes.canonical_rule: Do not merely spread UNIIMENTE. Spread capability.
nodes.statement: The extreme long-range aspiration is not a single dependent super-intelligence. It is a complex that becomes more capable by increasing the intelligence, knowledge, health, agency, prosperity, creativity, ownership, scientific capability, technology, infrastructure and coordination capacity of the surrounding ecosystem.
nodes.title: Regenerative civilization-industrial intelligence — spread capability, not dependence

nodes.statement: RESEARCH-IN is in scope as a sixth organ, but its exact canonical role must be derived from repository evidence. Do not invent its ownership, authority or interfaces merely to complete the diagram.
nodes.title: RESEARCH-IN is a sixth organ whose role must be derived, not invented

nodes.title: Canonical LEFT / CENTER / BRIDGE / RIGHT topology over REALITY

Track B may replace Track A components only after proving better results under protected evaluation and paying its complexity rent.
Do not abandon Track B merely because conventional mechanisms win today.
nodes.title: Two tracks — conventional organogenesis now, morphogenetic research alongside

regenerative mechanism that makes participants more capable, trusted, eligible and easier to transact with

It may contain useful policy and evidence mechanisms, but it must not become a parallel Constitution, authority root, identity root or Consequence Gate.
nodes.title: WMI is commercial cognition, never a second constitution
